title: CTRL-FM: Inference-Time Structural Control for Flow-Based Virtual Sensing under Long-Horizon Node Outages
abstract: arXiv:2610.30362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon node outages are harder than conventional missing-value imputation because complete sensor trajectories remain unobserved for extended periods, while the usefulness of spatial and temporal dependencies varies across outage locations and operating regimes. Existing graph, diffusion, and flow-based methods typically impose a fixed structural bias, which can oversmooth abrupt changes or propagate errors from unreliable neighbors. We introduce CTRL-FM, an observation-preserving flow-matching framework that treats structural guidance as an outage-conditioned inference-time decision. A missing-only flow-matching backbone learns a conditional velocity field while keeping observed measurements exactly fixed. For each realized outage, CTRL-FM constructs self-supervised proxy outages from surviving measurements and uses their known values to select among uncontrolled, graph-dominant, temporal-dominant, and balanced control policies. T

translated_title: CTRL-FM：长时节点中断下基于流的虚拟感知的推理时结构控制
translated_abstract: 长时间节点中断比传统的缺失值插补更为困难，因为完整的传感器轨迹在较长时间内处于未观测状态，而空间和时间依赖性的有用性会随中断位置和运行工况而变化。现有的基于图、扩散和流的方法通常施加固定的结构偏置，这可能会过度平滑突变或从不可靠的邻居传播错误。我们提出了CTRL-FM，一个保持观测数据的流匹配框架，它将结构引导视为以中断情况为条件的推理时决策。一个仅在缺失部分进行学习的流匹配主干网络学习条件速度场，同时将观测到的测量值严格保持固定。对于每次实际发生的中断，CTRL-FM从存活的测量数据中构建自监督代理中断，并利用其已知值在无控制、图主导、时间主导和平衡控制策略之间进行选择。
tldr: CTRL-FM提出了一个观测保持的流匹配框架，通过从存活数据构建自监督代理中断，在推理时自适应选择结构控制策略，以解决长时节点中断下虚拟感知中固定结构偏置导致的过平滑或误差传播问题。
en_tdlr: CTRL-FM is an observation-preserving flow-matching framework that constructs self-supervised proxy outages from surviving measurements to adaptively select structural control policies at inference time, addressing oversmoothing and error propagation in virtual sensing under long-horizon node outages.
